identity.original_title: DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain

hooks.text: 每次潜入沉没迷宫都要在黑暗怪物与氧气耗尽间赛跑
hooks.excerpt: Plunge into the cursed Abyssal Pool, where every descent is a deadly gamble. Navigate sunken ruins, face eldritch horrors in darkness, and race against dwindling oxygen.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 幸存者永久死亡，健康、理智与牺牲名单都由玩家决定
hooks.excerpt: Lead desperate survivors where death is permanent and sacrifice is inevitable. Manage health and sanity. Decide who joins, who dives, who dies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把脆弱营地建成人类最后避难所，按时间分配岗位与设施升级
hooks.excerpt: Transform your fragile camp into humanity's last refuge. Assign vital roles to your survivors, improve their skillset and craft them new tools & equipment. Balance resources against time to upgrade essential structures.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
